photos.author: xiquinhosilva
photos.description:
The Mleiha Archaeological Centre is a modern visitor centre and museum in the UAE dedicated to the region's rich archaeological heritage. Built around a well-preserved 4,500-year-old Umm Al Nar-era tomb, it showcases over 40 years of excavations revealing human presence in the area dating back 130,000 years, alongside artifacts from the Stone, Bronze, and Iron Ages through to the late pre-Islamic period.
The centre combines indoor displays with outdoor features, blending education on ancient cultures and their connection to the desert landscape.
